children: New Delhi, Sept. 11 -- Molbio Diagnostics shares are defying market sentiment, clocking stellar gains for the last three consecutive sessions. In morning trade on Friday, 11 September, Molbio Diagnostics share price jumped 11.7% to hit a fresh record high of Rs.1,686.50. In just three consecutive sessions, the stock has surged nearly 51% on the BSE, giving stellar rewards to its investors.

The newly-listed stock, which debuted on 17 August this year, has more than doubled investors' money. At the current market price of Rs.1,686.50, the stock has surged 109% from its issue price of Rs.807.

title: Molbio Diagnostics shares surge over 50% in just 3 days! What is driving the rally?
